name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1874: Two writers survived the last ship and both were the same shape: a fixture that isolated one path and not the others. The g5 suite patched the stats path in one class while every other class reaches the same helper through an env override, and the beacon test stubbed the network half while the beacon also writes his fleet history to disk. With his console down so nothing else could be blamed, a full gate run now leaves the whole tv tree byte-identical. The gate no longer watches a list of the leaks somebody already found: it fingerprints everything under tv and names anything that moves.
